# Archipelago application icon

`icon.png` is the unmodified `data/icon.png` from Archipelago 0.6.7:
https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/blob/0.6.7/data/icon.png

Upstream Git blob: `1d660434736b5fa681b664a4f0e2da8f42a9cf39`.

This file is covered by Archipelago's root MIT license, reproduced in `LICENSE`.
No artwork from the separately licensed `WebHostLib/static/static/branding`
directory is included. The icon identifies the Archipelago connection warning;
its use does not imply endorsement of this fork.
